Equipment entries

These entries describe the things you can carry, buy, find and use. Each gives its Bulk, price and any special requirements or effects. Record the actual item once in your inventory, even when several learned abilities use it. Buying equipment with coins does not buy training or a discipline rank.

Ordinary weapon appearance is yours to describe; your attack card supplies its combat mechanics. Special equipment adds only the effects printed here. For consumables, record the current inventory die and check it after the stated use. Keep frequently used items and occupied hands visible on your character sheet.

Equipment grants no training or DP advancement. Use ordinary item-handling actions unless an ability says otherwise. An item may come from an explicit ability grant, a purchase or DA treasure; owning it supplies only its printed benefits. It does not also supply a crafting recipe.
